trans-unit.id: Extended luminance range and 16-bpc for greater color accuracy (default is 8-bpc, SDR). With an HDR compatible Color Profile (`Display P3` recommended), HDR content is preserved when mirroring to an HDR/EDR display. Full screen stream and PIP window with both `Video Filters` and `HDR Filter Pipeline` enabled show proper HDR content or can be manually tone-mapped using an appropriate `Exposure` filter to differentiate HDR luminances up to virtual 10.000 nits.
trans-unit.source: Extended luminance range and 16-bpc for greater color accuracy (default is 8-bpc, SDR). With an HDR compatible Color Profile (`Display P3` recommended), HDR content is preserved when mirroring to an HDR/EDR display. Full screen stream and PIP window with both `Video Filters` and `HDR Filter Pipeline` enabled show proper HDR content or can be manually tone-mapped using an appropriate `Exposure` filter to differentiate HDR luminances up to virtual 10.000 nits.
trans-unit.target: Intervalo de luminância estendido e 16 bpc para maior precisão de cor (o padrão é 8 bpc, SDR). Com um perfil de cor compatível com HDR (`Display P3` recomendado), o conteúdo HDR é preservado ao espelhar para um monitor HDR/EDR. A transmissão em tela cheia e a janela PIP com `Filtros de vídeo` e `Processamento de filtros HDR` ativados exibem corretamente o conteúdo HDR. Também é possível aplicar mapeamento de tons manualmente com um filtro de `Exposição` apropriado para diferenciar luminâncias HDR de até 10.000 nits virtuais.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Help for the virtual screen HDR and 16-bit color setting. Backticked Video Filters, HDR Filter Pipeline and Exposure refer to localized UI controls; Display P3 is a color profile name.

Mantenha ⇧ Shift pressionado na inicialização para ativar o modo de segurança e evitar a aplicação automática. Em caso de problemas graves, reconecte fisicamente o monitor para restaurar o EDID original.

trans-unit.id: This can be a result of disabled DDC/CI support (check the display's OSD), display firmware limitations or connection issues. Many TVs and TV-derived smart monitors do not support DDC. If the issue cannot be resolved either by changing display settings or fixing cable issues, you should disable DDC support.
trans-unit.source: This can be a result of disabled DDC/CI support (check the display's OSD), display firmware limitations or connection issues. Many TVs and TV-derived smart monitors do not support DDC. If the issue cannot be resolved either by changing display settings or fixing cable issues, you should disable DDC support.
trans-unit.target: Isso pode ser resultado do suporte DDC/CI desativado (verifique o OSD do monitor), limitações de firmware do monitor ou problemas de conexão. Muitos televisores e monitores inteligentes derivados de TVs não suportam DDC. Se o problema não puder ser resolvido alterando as configurações do monitor ou corrigindo problemas com os cabos, você deve desativar o suporte DDC.

trans-unit.id: This configures how the data associated with the currently configured display is matched to a detected display during the configuration/detection process. Changing this setting might cause a display to be recognized as previously unconnected and disassociate existing saved display configuration data. System UUID match uses the macOS default identification. When set to use basic identifiers, the app identifies the display by its vendor/model IDs and serial number. With extended it also uses product name, alphanumeric serial number, and production date. With port and location the app also considers hardware connectivity data.
trans-unit.source: This configures how the data associated with the currently configured display is matched to a detected display during the configuration/detection process. Changing this setting might cause a display to be recognized as previously unconnected and disassociate existing saved display configuration data. System UUID match uses the macOS default identification. When set to use basic identifiers, the app identifies the display by its vendor/model IDs and serial number. With extended it also uses product name, alphanumeric serial number, and production date. With port and location the app also considers hardware connectivity data.
trans-unit.target: Define como os dados do monitor configurado são associados a um monitor detectado durante a configuração/detecção. Alterar esta opção pode fazer com que um monitor seja reconhecido como nunca conectado e desvincular suas configurações salvas. A correspondência de UUID do sistema usa a identificação padrão do macOS. Com identificadores básicos, o aplicativo usa os IDs de fabricante e modelo e o número de série. trans-unit.id: When HDR upscaling is enabled while hardware brightness control is disabled, the app uses a continuous brightness scale between zero and the calibrated max upscale value. Due to this the neutral setting (100⁠% brightness, when on-screen HDR content is unclipped) might not fall to an OSD chiclet boundary which makes it difficult to attain via the shortcut keys. To fix this an additional mid-chiclet step at 100⁠% brightness is inserted.
trans-unit.source: When HDR upscaling is enabled while hardware brightness control is disabled, the app uses a continuous brightness scale between zero and the calibrated max upscale value. Due to this the neutral setting (100⁠% brightness, when on-screen HDR content is unclipped) might not fall to an OSD chiclet boundary which makes it difficult to attain via the shortcut keys. To fix this an additional mid-chiclet step at 100⁠% brightness is inserted.
trans-unit.target: Quando a amplificação HDR está ativada e o controle de brilho por hardware está desativado, o aplicativo usa uma escala contínua entre zero e o valor máximo calibrado. Por isso, o nível neutro (100% de brilho, em que o conteúdo HDR na tela não perde detalhes) pode não coincidir com o limite de um segmento do OSD, dificultando alcançá-lo pelos atalhos. Para resolver isso, é inserido um passo adicional em 100% de brilho entre os limites dos segmentos.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Neutral software HDR brightness keyboard step setting help.

trans-unit.source: When this is enabled, the app will use the matching audio device's native audio controls (if available) instead of direct hardware control (via DDC or control integration). trans-unit.id:
⚠️ An EDID write operation modifies the EDID and DisplayID data on the device itself. Erroneous EDID data or a problem during EDID write might render the display permanently unusable!
Most displays do not allow EDID write for security reasons, some displays require EDID write to be activated in a service menu. Most EDID emulators or pass-thru dongles support EDID write. EDID write (if supported) usually works over HDMI.
trans-unit.source:
⚠️ An EDID write operation modifies the EDID and DisplayID data on the device itself. Erroneous EDID data or a problem during EDID write might render the display permanently unusable!
Most displays do not allow EDID write for security reasons, some displays require EDID write to be activated in a service menu. Most EDID emulators or pass-thru dongles support EDID write. EDID write (if supported) usually works over HDMI.
trans-unit.target:
⚠️ Uma operação de gravação EDID modifica os dados EDID e DisplayID no próprio dispositivo. Dados EDID errados ou um problema durante a gravação do EDID podem tornar o monitor permanentemente inutilizável!
A maioria dos monitores não permite a gravação de EDID por motivos de segurança; alguns monitores exigem que a gravação de EDID seja ativada em um menu de serviço. A maioria dos emuladores EDID ou dongles de passagem suportam gravação EDID. A gravação EDID (se compatível) geralmente funciona em HDMI.
trans-unit.note: 53477 - Hardware EDID write warning. This changes device-stored identification data, not a software override.

trans-unit.id: ⚠️ For this XDR display it is best to set calibration to Default - Auto Calibrate so the app can automatically adapt upscaling to the currently selected Apple Display Preset and environmental factors. For manual calibration set the brightness slider as high as possible while also making sure you still see the smiling face!
trans-unit.source: ⚠️ For this XDR display it is best to set calibration to Default - Auto Calibrate so the app can automatically adapt upscaling to the currently selected Apple Display Preset and environmental factors. For manual calibration set the brightness slider as high as possible while also making sure you still see the smiling face!

Para calibrar manualmente, ajuste o controle deslizante de brilho para o valor mais alto possível em que ainda consiga ver o rosto sorridente!
